newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila shares end lower for third straight day.
newsitem.headline: Manila shares end lower for third straight day.

text.p: Manila shares trekked lower for the third straight day on Thursday as the market continued its consolidation phase on a dearth of market-moving news, traders said.
The main index shaved off 12.48 points to 3,222.56 points following Wednesday's 1.44-point decline.
"No one is willing to commit more money aggressively at this point," said Lito Vicencio of Peregrine Securities.
"There's not much going on. We're waiting for third quarter results," Vicencio added.
Traders said only local investors were moving the market, while foreigners stayed on the sidelines.
The market has also been damped by uncertainty over a possible U.S. interest rate hike which may be announced after the U.S. presidential elections in November, they said.
Newly-listed high technology stock, Music Semiconductors, defied the market trend. It ended at 7.80 pesos, 24 percent higher than the offer price of 6.30 pesos.
